subject: kuo-toan
fact: Eight kuo-toans ambush the group, with four attacking from the front and four from the rear.
source_quote: the group is ambushed by eight kuo-toans—four creatures attack from the front and four from the rear.

subject: Kuo-Toan monitor
fact: A Kuo-Toan monitor is a special kind of Kuo-Toan leader who provides structured organization over a Kuo-Toan group.
source_quote: A Kuo-Toan monitor is a special kind of Kuo-Toan leader who provides structured organization over a Kuo-Toan group.

subject: Kuo-Toan monitor
fact: The Kuo-Toan monitor’s primary role is to deal with any sudden break of insanity.
source_quote: the monitor’s primary role is to deal with any sudden break of insanity.

subject: Kuo-Toan monitor
fact: When the Kuo-Toan monitor is defeated, the Kuo-toans are less likely to keep fighting.
source_quote: when the monitor is defeated, the Kuo-toans are less likely to keep fighting.

subject: liquid from kuo-toan bodies
fact: The body of the kuo-toans releases a liquid that causes any melee weapon to stick to their bodies.
source_quote: the body of the Kuo-toans releases a particular liquid that causes any melee weapon to stick to their bodies.

subject: liquid from kuo-toan bodies
fact: Only the application of strength can free a weapon from the liquid glue.
source_quote: Only the application of strength can from a weapon from the glue.

subject: hand-held crossbows
fact: A collection of hand-held crossbows, combined with a united team, can create a powerful enough force to take down a formidable group of enemies.
source_quote: a collection of hand-held crossbows, combined with a united team, can create a powerful enough force to take down even a formidable group of enemies.

subject: kuo-toan
fact: Three of the kuo-toans flee into the Underdark, including the monitor.
source_quote: Three of the Kuo-toans flee into the Underdark, including the monitor.

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar sighs and questions why the ambush occurred.
source_quote: Shuushar sighs, “Such an unnecessary battle. Why would this be happening?”

subject: Sethir
fact: Sethir mutters whether the group should continue.
source_quote: Sethir mutters, “Should we continue?”

subject: Shuushar the Awakened
fact: Shuushar the Awakened says ‘Yes’ to continuing.
source_quote: “Yes,” the Shuushar the Awakened says.

subject: Sloobludop
fact: An hour from Sloobludop, another kuo-toan party appears.
source_quote: An hour from Sloobludop, another kuo-toan party appears.

subject: Ploopploopeen
fact: Ploopploopeen is the archpriest of the Sea Mother.
source_quote: “This is Ploopploopeen, archpriest of the Seamother.”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum finds the name Ploopploopeen very funny and tries not to laugh out loud.
source_quote: Grygum finds the name very funny and tries not to laugh out loud.

subject: Ploopploopeen
fact: Ploopploopeen says the Sea Mother has answered her prayers.
source_quote: “The Seamother has answered my prayers!”

subject: kuo-toan
fact: Ploopploopeen is accompanied by other members of her kind who follow her like a school of fish.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen has come with other members of her kind, and as she talks, she walks around. They follow her like a school of fish, walking here and there in circles.

subject: Darklake
fact: Bloppblippodd’s followers cast bloody chum into the waters of the Darklake, where it is consumed by something.
source_quote: killing blood sacrifices then casting bloody chum into the waters of the Darklake, where it is consumed by … something.

subject: Topsy
fact: Topsy asks if the kuo-toan problems are the party’s concern.
source_quote: “I hear about your problems, and that sounds like a you problem, not like a me problem. What can we help with you?”

subject: Ploopploopeen
fact: Ploopploopeen wants to use the party as bait to infiltrate the Deep Father’s cult.
source_quote: “I wish to use you as bait.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir looks at Ploopploopeen unimpressed when she offers to use them as bait.
source_quote: Zalthir looks at her, unimpressed.

subject: Ploopploopeen
fact: Ploopploopeen explains that the Deep Father’s followers make offerings by killing blood sacrifices and casting chum into the Darklake.
source_quote: The followers of the Deep Father have been making an increasing number of offerings on his altar — killing blood sacrifices then casting bloody chum into the waters of the Darklake, where it is consumed by … something.

subject: Ploopploopeen
fact: Ploopploopeen says the Sea Mother is the traditional faith of the Kuo-toans and the Deep Father is the real evil.
source_quote: “The Seamother is not a weird religion. It is the traditional faith of the Kuo-toans! It is Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father that is the real evil!”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz suggests killing Ploopploopeen if she keeps talking endlessly.
source_quote: “If Ploopploo-whatever is going to keep talking endlessly like that, maybe we should kill them?”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar says the Sea Mother is an old god and the Deep Father is who they should fight against.
source_quote: “No, no, no. The Sea Mother is an old god, the Deep Father, that is who we should fight against. The Deep Mother demands humanoid sacrifices, not the Sea Mother.”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz says he does not want to listen to the drivel anymore.
source_quote: “I don’t want to listen to this drivel all the time.”

subject: Shuushar
fact: Shuushar suggests talking to Bloppblippodd before taking action.
source_quote: “Perhaps we should talk to his daughter before we take action? I have learned that one must open themselves to all points of view and then only then make decisions and judgments.”

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir shouts to the archpriest to confirm the reward.
source_quote: Zalthir shouts to the archpriest, “You said reward?”

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum says the party has temporal needs alongside spiritual ones.
source_quote: “I am all about the spiritual stuff, but the temporal have needs too.”

subject: 500 gold
fact: Ploopploopeen promises 500 gold as a reward for the party’s aid.
source_quote: The archpriest promises 500 gold and two potions of healing.

subject: two potions of healing
fact: Ploopploopeen promises two potions of healing as a reward for the party’s aid.
source_quote: The archpriest promises 500 gold and two potions of healing.

subject: two boats
fact: Ploopploopeen offers two boats as part of the reward after the party is unimpressed with the initial offer.
source_quote: “Two boats and guides to navigate the Darklake?”

subject: guides to navigate the Darklake
fact: Ploopploopeen offers guides to navigate the Darklake as part of the reward.
source_quote: “Two boats and guides to navigate the Darklake?”

subject: Daz
fact: Daz asks how many members the Deep Father’s faction has.
source_quote: Daz asks, “How many members does the other faction have?”

subject: Ploopploopeen
fact: Ploopploopeen tells Daz not to worry about the number of members in the other faction.
source_quote: “Do not worry yourself about that. All you have to do is distract Bloppblippodd enough. I will take care of her, and my followers will take care of the followers of this false god.”

subject: Bloppblippodd
fact: Bloppblippodd is Ploopploopeen’s daughter and the archpriest of Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father.
source_quote: a few weeks ago, Bloppblippodd, Ploopploopeen’s daughter, experienced a powerful vision of “Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father,” proclaiming him the new god of her people.

subject: Bloppblippodd
fact: Bloppblippodd has backed her claims of being the new prophet with a tremendous increase in magical power.
source_quote: She has backed up her claims with a tremendous increase in magical power, and new followers have flocked to her.

subject: Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father
fact: Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father is proclaimed as the new god by Bloppblippodd.
source_quote: Bloppblippodd, Ploopploopeen’s daughter, experienced a powerful vision of “Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father,” proclaiming him the new god of her people.

subject: followers of the Deep Father
fact: The followers of the Deep Father have been making increasing offerings on his altar by killing blood sacrifices and casting chum into the Darklake.
source_quote: The followers of the Deep Father have been making an increasing number of offerings on his altar — killing blood sacrifices then casting bloody chum into the waters of the Darklake, where it is consumed by … something.

subject: followers of the Sea Mother
fact: The followers of the Sea Mother are the traditional believers who oppose the cult of Leemooggoogoon the Deep Father.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen explains that the inhabitants of Sloobludop have lived in harmonious service to the will of the Sea Mother for some time.

subject: infiltration plan
fact: Ploopploopeen plans to use the party as infiltrators disguised as sacrifices to disrupt the Deep Father’s rituals.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen will offer them as a “token of peace and reconciliation” to get closer to the archpriest of the Deep Father — except the adventurers will not be helpless prisoners but infiltrators.

subject: disruption of rituals
fact: Ploopploopeen wants the party to disrupt the upstart faction’s rituals so her true believers can cut off the head of the cult.
source_quote: Ploopploopeen wants them to disrupt the upstart faction’s rituals, allowing his true believers of the Sea Mother to cut off the head of the cult.

subject: language spell cast
fact: Ploopploopeen’s interlocutor casts a spell that makes the Kuo-toan language and communication nuances clear to the party.
source_quote: Just then, his interlocutor casts a spell, and suddenly, not only is their language clear, but also the nuances of their communication and body language.

subject: party huddles
fact: The escapees huddle in a group to discuss whether to kill Ploopploopeen.
source_quote: The escapees huddle in a group.

subject: reward agreement
fact: The escapees agree to Ploopploopeen’s offer of two boats and guides to navigate the Darklake as reward.
source_quote: The escapees nod in agreement.
